name: io.github.samihalawa/email-smtp-imap-mcp
description: Multi-account SMTP/IMAP email tools: search, read, send, reply, forward, flags and folders.

environmentVariables.name: EMAIL_ACCOUNTS_JSON
environmentVariables.description: JSON object keyed by account name with SMTP and IMAP settings and credentials; see the repository setup guide.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_EMAIL_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Default account name from EMAIL_ACCOUNTS_JSON; optional when the first account should be used.
